Special Condition: “To avail the relaxation from past experience of similar services, the probable bidders must have MSME Udyam cer tificate with certification under any one out of the following two N ational Industrial Classification (NIC) codes i.e. 77100 (Renting and

leasing of motor vehicles) & 79110 (Travel agency activities).” Note: In case the MSME Certificate submitted by the participating bidder is NOT registered under the above-mentioned NIC codes: i) the bid shall be evaluated as that of a Non-MSME bidder, and the eligibility and qualification criteria applicable to Non-MSME bidders sha ll apply; and ii) The bidder shall be required to submit the Earnest Money Deposit (EM D) applicable to Non-MSME bidders, failing which the bid shall be treat ed as non-responsive. 2. Following additional documents to be uploaded. Additional Document 1: Bidders are requested to submit a list of vehicles along with copies of RC Bo ok. A minimum of 1 no. of any Sedan/ SUV/ Premium SUV/ Commercially Ow ned Passenger vehicle is required. The vehicle should be with Registration Year i.e. 2023 / 2024 / 2025 / 2026 model and registered under bidder’s na me as a commercial vehicle in RTO of any city of India. Vehicle to be registered in the name of owner’s/proprietor’s name (in case of Proprietorship) and in the name of the firm only (in case of Limited Comp any and Partnership Company). In case of Limited Company or Partnership Company, the ownership of the vehicle in the name of director/partner shall not be considered and bid shall be considered as non-responsive. RC book document must be provided/uploaded as a proof of ownership. Additional Document 2: Vendor should have a registered office address in Gujarat. Documentary pr oof to be provided/uploaded. “The bid will be considered non-responsive if the above-mentioned details and documents are not provided / uploaded on GeM portal during Technical Evaluation.” 4. The vehicle provided by successful nominated L-1 bidder should be as “Co mmercial Vehicle”.

5. All the vehicles deployed shall comply with all the rules and regulations, sti pulations enforced from time to time by transport authorities (RTO) and oth er government, local, statutory bodies. In case of any violations the penalty/charges incurred will be the liability of the contractor and nothing e xtra shall be payable. 6. All vehicles should be compulsory equipped with an Emergency Medical kit and a Fire Extinguisher. 7. The tentative date for deployment of all the vehicles will be as per GeM Con tract, Actual number of vehicles to be deployed will be decided by Officer in -charge, however contractor will have to make sure the availability of vehicl e as & when required by the buyer. 8. Deployed vehicle shall have properly cleaned interiors and exteriors. Suitab le air freshener shall be kept inside vehicle. Tissue Paper box should also be there in each vehicle. 9. During the currency of Contract, vehicle can not be used for any other purp ose except for NHSRCL. 10. Number of vehicles may be increased or decreased during the contract peri od by giving notice period of 01 month. No claim whatsoever shall be admis sible on this account by the contractor. 11. All vehicles deployed shall arrive at designated location on time as per the requirement of buyer and with full or sufficient tank of fuel. 12. In case of fuel type as Gas, the same should be company fitted only. 13. Deployed Vehicle should have active Fast tag all the time during the contra ct time period. 14. Vehicle shall be required for full calendar month excluding Sunday and Holi days. However, in case of exigencies and emergencies, the vehicle can be called on Sundays also. In such case the Contractor will provide suitable su bstitute alternative arrangement of vehicle / Driver for ensuring weekly rest s to regular driver as per extant laws. 15. The base station for the deployment of vehicle can be Vadodara/Nadiad/An and/Ahmedabad/Surat and the vehicle can be used anywhere in Gujarat. N o extra payment shall be made for usage of vehicle in Gujarat as this is the local definition as per NHSRCL. 16. The contractor shall provide skilled drivers. The drivers provided on the ve hicles shall be fully aware of the geography of area of working. They should also be aware of traffic rules and prevailing law and order in the area of wor king and in the state of Gujarat. Drivers on hired vehicle should be deploye d only after submission of Police Verification Certificate of his credentials an d valid driving -12- Special Conditions of Contract e-Procurement Document

s (SCC) license. In absence of police verification certificate of driver, vehicle shall not be considered for hiring. The vehicle should be registered with the concerned authority of Central or State Government with payment of road t ax and have a comprehensive insurance policy. The driver of the vehicle m ust follow traffic rules and other regulations prescribed by the government from time to time. Copies of registration certificate of vehicle, evidence for payment of road tax, insurance premium, valid driving license should be su bmitted as and when demanded. The rate shall be deemed to be inclusive cost of driver for vehicle, police verifications, all consumables for running of vehicles, repair and maintenance of vehicle (both preventive and breakdow n), insurance, road tax etc. as well as all taxes pertaining to run vehicle on road. No extra payment shall be made on this account. All liabilities pertaini ng to agency’s staff and personnel shall be borne by contractor. NHSRCL sh all not be liable for any compensation. 17. The agency shall ensure that every driver is equipped with a mobile phone (with both incoming and outgoing call facilities) at the Service Provider’s co st. The officer using the vehicle shall have full rights to contact the driver at any time. Additionally, the Service Provider shall furnish the contact details of their office staff, including the coordinator and authorized representative , and must provide a 24-hour operational contact number for communicatio n with NHSRCL. The Driver should have a mobile along with Google Maps a nd should be aware of the surrounding in Vadodara and nearby areas. 18. Driver should have adequate amount with him during the travel for emerge ncy repairs parking, filling of diesel/Petrol and oil etc. The contractor should provide fast-tag to the driver for payment of toll tax. 19. Driver should never be under the influence of alcohol during Duty hours. Co ntractor shall replace the driver permanently in case of non-compliance. 20. Service provider shall have to maintain Utilization certificate approved by NHSRCL’s officials and has to be submitted along with monthly IPC bill. 21. NHSRCL will not provide separate parking space of any kind. Parking availa ble with NHSRCL office may be used as per instructions of NHSRCL. 22. The kilometers will be counted from designated stations as advised by NHS RCL officers / users. The running mileage count will start from the location o f pickup-Drop point and no extra kilometers from the garage to the pickup- Drop point will be counted. If desired by the NHSRCL officials, the vehicle sh ould be parked at NHSRCL official’s premise only. No extra claim whatsoever shall be entertained on this account. 23. Payment of hiring charges will be made on monthly basis on submission of Tax invoice & approved IPC along with all requisite documents and paymen t shall be arranged after the due verification of all relevant documents by th e NHSRCL. The month shall be the calendar month i.e. from 1st day to co mpletion of month end. 24. During outstation duty, no accommodation will be provided to the driver by

NHSRCL. Agency has to make arrangements for lodging, boarding and food etc. of the driver. 25. Valid Police verifications for deployed staff shall be ensured by Contractor / Service provider before engaging the staff. 26. NHSRCL reserves the right to close the Contract at any time without assigni ng any reasons thereat by giving a 30 days’ notice. Contractor shall not be entitled for any compensation in such eventuality. 27. Performance Security Amount: “Within 15 days from date of issue of th e GeM contract, the successful Tenderer shall furnish Performance Security, for an amount of five percent (5%) of the Accepted Contract Amount in the form of a Bank Draft, FDR or in the form of a Bank Guarantee from a sched uled commercial bank in India (but excluding Cooperative Banks) acceptabl e to the Employer. The Extension of time for submission of Performance Se curity beyond 15 (Fifteen) days from date of issue of GeM contract may be given by the Authority who is competent to sign the Contract Agreement. H owever, a Penal Interest of 15% per annum shall be charged for the entire period i.e. from the date of issue of GeM contract to the date of submission of Performance Security.” Further, the buyer shall have the right to recover the performance security from the Contractor’s running bill, if not submitted within stipulated time. In case, if Contract is terminated due to Contractor's default, the full 5% Per formance Security amount shall be forfeited. 28. The Contractor should submit the details and documents of the vehicle pro vided to this office immediately after award of GeM Contract. The vehicle d ocuments submitted, should clearly mention the date of purchase, make, m odel, Registration no. Chassis no., type of fuel i.e. Diesel/Petrol/Any. The ag reement will be considered operated from the date from which the vehicle i s actually pressed into service. 29. The vehicle provided to NHSRCL must be fully and comprehensively insure d covering the risk to the driver and all the passengers also. The Insurance shall protect the contractor and NHSRCL against all risk, claims for loss, Inju ries, disability, disease and death of members of public including NHSRCL of ficials and damage to the property of others arising from the use of vehicle during operations respective of the ownership of such vehicle. 30. In the event service provider commits default/breach in fulfilling contractua l obligations i.e., default (s) in commencing the work, fails to maintain the r equired services, work not done as per specifications, abandons the work, p ersistently disregard to instruction of the Engineer or contravenes any provi sions of the contract etc., Employer will be entitled to forfeit the Performanc e Security and /or may reserve the right to forfeit the Performance Security. 31. Running of vehicle shall include sites having katcha roads, hilly terrains, et c. Duty time shall be decided by the controlling officer of the vehicle. If due to some reason vehicle is required beyond 12 hrs per day then Contractor

will have to provide a separate driver or substitute vehicle to be provided a s per requirement of NHSRCL. 32. In the event of outstation travel, NHSRCL will neither provide accommodati on nor pay any additional allowance to the driver. The driver/service provid er is responsible for making their own arrangements. 33. Termination: NHSRCL may terminate after the occurrence of any of the ev ents as specified below: a. If the Contractor commits breach of contract or do not remedy/ rectify a failure in the providing the service of their obligations under the Cont ract provisions/ any terms and conditions mentioned above. b. In the event of a report of unsatisfactory service from the concerned N HSRCL official, after taking into consideration any other fact as may be relevant on a case to case basis. c. If the NHSRCL, in its sole discretion, decided to terminate the Contract at any stage in case the services are no longer required. Such terminat ion will not attract any penalties or shall not be liable for any extra pay ments other than payment of invoices raised till the time of terminatio n. 34. The contractor shall, at their own cost, arrange and maintain a comprehens ive insurance policy for each vehicle, including third-party liability, covering the full value sufficient for replacement in case of loss or damage. The insurance must remain valid for the entire duration of the contract. Each ve hicle must be fully insured to cover all possible liabilities, damages, injuries, or deaths involving the driver, passengers, or third parties, regardl ess of vehicle ownership. NHSRCL shall not be liable for any compensation arising from accidents, losses, or incidents including those due to militant a ctivities. 35. NHSRCL reserves the right to change the headquarters of a vehicle during t he contract period as and when required and it will be binding on the contr actor. Any disobedience to this clause will count as breach of contract. 36. Speedometer and kilometre recorder shall be maintained to high standard/ accuracy. Any defect not iced shall be rectified immediately. NHSRCL reser ves the right to get the meter calibrated or checked at any time at its sole d iscretion. Tempering/manipulation of meter reading and misbehavior of driv er shall be viewed seriously. Penalty will be imposed as per penalty clause. In case of repeat of tempering, NHSRCL may even decide to terminate the c ontract and forfeiture of Performance Guarantee in the event of any error/f ault in the meter being noticed. The kilometers verified by official using the vehicle shall be final and binding. 37. Contractor shall have to maintain logbook by officer-in-charge which shall h ave to be filled daily after usage and presented to NHSRCL’s authorized rep resentative for signature. 38. Payment of hiring charges will be made on monthly basis on submission of

bill and after the due verification of log books by the NHSRCL official. 39. The Contractor shall deploy only those vehicles which are registered in the name of the Contractor/Agency. However, in exceptional or unavoidable cir cumstances, deployment of third-party or hired vehicles may be permitted subject to the approval of the Competent Authority. The Contractor shall en sure that such vehicles fully comply with all statutory, insurance, and safety requirements and are maintained in good working condition at all times. 40. Variation of Contract Quantities or Contract Value or Contract Dur ation: The NHSRCL can increase or decrease the contract quantities or con tract value or contract duration up to 50 percent of the accepted contract. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantities or value or duration. 41. Secrecy/Non-Disclosure- The contractor shall ensure that all the informatio n is kept totally confidential in connection with this bid and the contractor s hall not disclose or divulge the same to any unauthorized person failing whi ch Employer/Officer in Charge reserve the right to cancel the contact or ce ase further dealing with the service provider. .
